title: Air Conditioning Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Urban Company is a technology-driven platform that connects customers with vetted professionals for a wide range of home and beauty services, including repairs, cleaning, salon, and spa experiences. The company focuses on making urban living easier through reliable, high-quality, and transparent services. Operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and KSA, Urban Company also offers Native, its in-house brand of smart home solutions that enhance safety and convenience at home. Skill India–certified professionals, trained through comprehensive programs in partnership with NSDC, are at the core of the platform, ensuring consistent service standards and sustainable livelihoods for partners. Urban Company is committed to professional development, service excellence, and a supportive work environment for trainers and service experts alike.
  
**Role Description**
As an Air Conditioning Trainer at Urban Company in Kochi, you will conduct hands-on training sessions for air conditioning service professionals, covering installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair techniques. You will design and update training materials, curricula, and practical demos to align with current industry standards, safety regulations, and Urban Company quality guidelines. The role involves assessing trainees’ skills, providing constructive feedback, and supporting certification processes to ensure consistent service quality. You will collaborate with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps, standardize best practices, and implement improvements across the service network. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, requiring regular classroom and workshop-based training interactions with service partners.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in air conditioning systems, including installation, preventive maintenance, and fault diagnosis.
* Experience in delivering vocational or technical training, with the ability to design clear training modules, practice exercises, and assessment methods.
* Solid understanding of safety standards, electrical safety practices, and compliance requirements relevant to HVAC and home services.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, practical terms to diverse learner groups.
* Ability to mentor and coach service professionals, providing structured feedback and supporting continuous skill improvement.
* Basic familiarity with digital tools (e.g., smartphones, learning platforms, and documentation software) to manage training schedules and records.
* Prior experience in HVAC, home services, or facilities management; certification or diploma in mechanical/electrical or HVAC disciplines is highly beneficial.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and professional ethics.

title: Federal Proposal Writer
description:
Job Title

**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager – GSA MAS**

Job Type

Full-Time | Remote

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced
**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager**
with strong knowledge of the
**U.S. federal contracting environment**
, particularly
**GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
opportunities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting the full federal business development lifecycle, including
**opportunity identification, capture strategy, solicitation analysis, proposal development, compliance, pricing coordination, and submission**
.

The candidate will work closely with business development, recruiting, delivery, contracts, pricing, and leadership teams to develop compelling, compliant, and competitive proposals for federal government opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**Federal Capture Management**

* Identify and evaluate federal contracting opportunities aligned with company capabilities and growth objectives.
* Support the capture lifecycle from
  **early opportunity identification through proposal submission and award**
  .
* Develop and maintain
  **capture plans, opportunity assessments, win strategies, call plans, and action plans**
  .
* Analyze agency requirements, procurement history, incumbent information, competition, contract vehicles, and anticipated acquisition strategies.
* Track opportunities through
  **SAM.gov, GSA eBuy, agency procurement forecasts, and other federal procurement sources**
  .
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to establish bid/no-bid recommendations based on documented opportunity factors.

**Proposal Development & Writing**

* Lead or support the development of federal government proposals, RFIs, Sources Sought responses, RFQs, RFP responses, capability statements, and task-order proposals.
* Develop persuasive content for
  **Technical, Management, Staffing, Past Performance, Corporate Experience, and Executive Summary**
  sections.
* Translate technical and operational information from SMEs into clear, compliant, evaluator-focused proposal content.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices, annotated outlines, storyboards, and content plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly address
  **Section L instructions and Section M evaluation criteria**
  , where applicable.
* Coordinate proposal inputs from SMEs, recruiting, operations, finance, contracts, and leadership.
* Edit and quality-check proposal content for clarity, consistency, grammar, formatting, and compliance.

**GSA MAS Experience**

* Support proposal and contract activities associated with the
  **GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
  .
* Demonstrate familiarity with the GSA MAS solicitation structure, SINs, labor categories, pricing requirements, and applicable proposal documentation.
* Assist with identifying appropriate
  **Special Item Numbers (SINs)**
  based on company capabilities.
* Support preparation and maintenance of GSA MAS-related documentation, including labor category descriptions, qualifications, pricing information, and supporting narratives.
* Understand the importance of maintaining consistency between the company's capabilities, labor categories, pricing, and federal proposal submissions.
* Support responses to GSA/eBuy RFQs and task-order opportunities under applicable contract vehicles.

**Compliance & Proposal Management**

* Develop and maintain detailed
  **compliance matrices**
  mapping solicitation requirements to proposal responses.
* Track solicitation amendments, questions and answers, deadlines, deliverables, and proposal responsibilities.
* Conduct color-team reviews such as
  **Pink Team, Red Team, and Gold Team**
  reviews as appropriate.
* Identify proposal gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and missing solicitation requirements before submission.
* Maintain proposal libraries, reusable content, past-performance information, resumes, corporate qualifications, and relevant project descriptions.

**Business Development & Capture Support**

* Collaborate with leadership and business development teams to strengthen federal market positioning.
* Research federal agencies, buying patterns, competitors, incumbents, and upcoming procurements.
* Assist with development of
  **capability statements, one-pagers, presentations, white papers, and sources-sought responses**
  .
* Support teaming and subcontractor research when required.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and capture information within CRM or pipeline-management systems.

Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of experience**
  in federal proposal writing, capture management, business development, or federal contracting.
* Demonstrated experience with
  **U.S. federal government proposals and solicitations**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **GSA MAS / GSA eBuy**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of federal solicitation terminology, including
  **RFI, Sources Sought, RFQ, RFP, SOW, PWS, SOO, L/M sections, evaluation criteria, and compliance matrices**
  .
* Experience researching opportunities through
  **SAM.gov**
  and other federal procurement resources.
* Strong proposal writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills.
* Experience working with technical SMEs and translating technical information into proposal-ready content.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and competing deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify compliance gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting
  **GSA MAS SINs and eBuy opportunities**
  .
* Experience with
  **IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, BOA, and task-order competitions**
  .
* Knowledge of federal acquisition processes and
  **FAR/DFARS**
  requirements.
* Experience with federal staffing, IT services, professional services, or technology contracts.
* Experience supporting
  **8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, or other small-business federal contracting programs**
  .
* Proposal certification such as
  **APMP**
  is a plus.
* Experience with proposal management tools, CRM systems, or platforms such as
  **GovWin, Deltek, Salesforce, Loopio, Responsive, or similar systems**
  .

Core Competencies

* Federal Proposal Writing
* Capture Management
* GSA MAS
* GSA eBuy
* Federal Business Development
* SME Coordination
* Proposal Reviews
* FAR/DFARS Awareness
* SAM.gov Research
* Task-Order Proposal Development

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should understand
**how to interpret the solicitation once released, and how to turn that strategy into a compliant and persuasive proposal**
.

Particular value will be placed on candidates who have
**personally supported GSA MAS activities and GSA eBuy opportunities**
, rather than candidates whose experience is limited to commercial proposals.

title: EDI Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The EDI Support Analyst will be responsible for supporting NOV’s electronic data interchange (EDI) and business\-to\-business (B2B) integrations within the Shared Services organization. This position focuses on production support, customer onboarding, and project coordination to ensure stable and efficient data exchange between NOV and its trading partners. The role requires a balance of technical acumen, communication skills, and process discipline to drive seamless integration, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across NOV’s EDI/B2B landscape.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide day\-to\-day production support for EDI/B2B transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and issue resolution.
* Monitor and troubleshoot EDI transaction failures and coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve them promptly.
* Support onboarding of new customers and suppliers to NOV’s EDI/B2B platforms.
* Partner with business users and ERP technical teams to analyze integration requirements and implement new EDI/B2B connections.
* Coordinate testing, documentation, and deployment of EDI/B2B enhancements or projects.
* Maintain transaction performance reports and support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability and data quality.
* Document and maintain partner profiles and process flows.
* Collaborate with Shared Services, Operations, and external trading partners to ensure alignment in business processes and system capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in EDI/B2B integration, including production support and project coordination.
* Working knowledge of EDI standards (e.g., ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML) and related transaction sets.
* Familiarity with integration of middleware tools (e.g., BizTalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with supply chain transactions like RFQ/Quote/PO/SO/Ship Notice/Invoice etc.
* Experience managing incident tickets and change requests (Jira, or similar).
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with customer/vendor onboarding and production support in a supply chain environment.
* Exposure to Shared Services or global IT support functions.
* Understanding of ERP integrations, preferably Oracle PO/SO/Ship/Invoice modules.

title: Content Writing Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.
 



 We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.
 



 This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.
 



 You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager
* Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing
* Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from
* Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction
* Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it
* Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing
* Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this
* SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it
* Campaign strategy or audience definition
* Client\-facing communications of any kind



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience** 




  




* Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.
* Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.
* Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.
* Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.



  





**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.
* Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind
* Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism
* Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.



  





**Mindset** 



* Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world
* Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing
* Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited
* Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently
* Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening
* Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability
* Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1
* Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.
 



  





 If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
 



  





 Benefits
 



 A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

 Learning strategy and capability building

 Learning technology and measurement
   

  

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
